subject: RE: FW: ZURICH AIRPORT - SCL / 206 CRATES 203 KGS
body:
Dear Air Freight Team,

I am arranging air freight from Germany for our buyer’s import into Riyadh, SA. Could you please quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest option from DUS to RUH?

We will deliver the goods to DUS ourselves. The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-28 and consists of 10 pieces of machine parts, with a gross weight of 508 kg and a volume of 1.83 cbm.

Please confirm the earliest available departure and expected arrival at RUH so our buyer can plan for the import.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-10-26
Subject: ZURICH AIRPORT - SCL / 206 CRATES 203 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex ZURICH AIRPORT to SCL:
206 CRATES / 203 KGS / 17.3 CBM, automotive sensors
FCA, cargo ready next week.

Thanks
